name: The Sea Raiders
about: Longships come out of the western sea and burn a coastal lord's towns. He begs the crown for help. If help doesn't come, he makes his own peace with the raiders and sends them at Kingsmere.
title: The Sea Raiders

beats.speaker: coast
beats.text: Black sails off {harbour} at dawn. By dusk the harbour is burning, and the raiders have sailed off with its silver and its daughters.

court.text: {coast} of {coast.house}: "Raiders from the sea burned {harbour}, Your Grace, and they'll be back with more ships. My house can't hold the whole coast alone."

options.label: Pay for war galleys to guard the coast (300 gold)
options.result: Royal galleys sail from the river mouth to guard {coast.house}'s shore.

options.label: Order {neighbour.house} to send men to the coast
options.result: {neighbour.house}'s spearmen march to {harbour}, complaining about guarding another lord's coast.

options.label: Let each lord guard his own shore
options.result: The crown sends {hall} its regrets. {coast} doesn't reply.

beats.speaker: coast
beats.text: The raiders come back with forty ships and a king of their own, and this time they stay. They spend the winter at {harbour}.

court.text: {neighbour} of {neighbour.house}: "The sea king has taken {harbour}, Your Grace, and {coast} is talking terms with him. Drive them into the sea, or pay them off before {coast} makes a deal."

options.label: Pay the sea king to sail home (500 gold)
options.hint: they leave · they'll come back for more
options.result: The sea king takes the crown's gold and sails west. Everyone knows he'll be back.

options.label: Send the royal host to drive them out (300 gold)
options.result: The royal host marches west. On the beach below {harbour}, the sea king finds out what knights can do.

options.label: Let {coast} deal with them
options.hint: {coast.houseName} −30 · {coast.he} may make {coast.his} own deal with them
options.result: The crown leaves {coast} to face the sea king alone. {coast} sends a ship to the raiders' camp under a white flag.

beats.speaker: coast
beats.text: {coast} makes a deal with the sea king: the coast goes to {coast.house}, and Kingsmere's treasury goes to the raiders. The longships sail up the river, and {coast.house} marches beside them.

beats.speaker: neighbour
beats.text: The raiders are driven into the sea, and their burning ships light up the coast all night. They won't come back while this King lives.

beats.speaker: coast
beats.text: The sea king takes the crown's gold and leaves. {harbour} rebuilds, and keeps watch on the western sea.
